## Increment
Adaptive residual-first selection: at each iteration choose a prefix with smallest nonzero number of unresolved assignments, ties in R296 bank order, then least remaining binary assignment. Reuse R297 integer phase-I and R298 subcube propagation. The unresolved mask is the exact direct-capacity mask less inherited certified rejections, new certified rejections and separately stored feasible witnesses. For each positive-dependence core, intersect its singleton subcube with every compatible prefix's unresolved mask; remove exactly that intersection. A feasible witness is kept as its own unresolved-suffix case, not a rejection. By induction, each removed rejection contains the signed support of a verified positive dependence, and no rejection is counted twice. All other signs, original germ masks and original label observers remain intact. A prefix with no remaining algebra-unknown assignments but at least one separator is NOT closed for suffix purposes. The procedure is a scheduling improvement, not a complexity claim or new theorem about the mother problem.
